facts.fact: The Public Private Partnership Commission's DIGMAP 'Luntha ndi Chuma' digital skills initiative, World Bank-funded and run through 9 tech hubs, reports that NXTGen Labs alone has trained 3,371 youths and women in Mzimba, Mzuzu, Lilongwe, Blantyre and Zomba.
